verifications.note: FERC EA availability notice itemizes each Appalachian Gateway Project pipeline facility by diameter: 'the 5.3 miles, 20-inch-diameter TL-570, EXT. 1 pipeline in Kanawha County, West Virginia; the 6 mile, 24-inch-diameter TL-492, EXT. 5 pipeline in Greene County, Pennsylvania; the 42.3 mile 30-inch-diameter TL-590 pipeline in Marshall and Greene Counties, Pennsylvania; the 54.2 mile, 24-inch-diameter TL-591 pipeline...; the 0.5 mile, 16 inch-diameter TL-596...; the 0.1 mile, 10-inch-diameter TL-597...; the 0.3 mile, 16-inch-diameter TL-598...' -- states 20-, 24-, and 30-inch as the mainline diameters (plus shorter 16-in and 10-in laterals/loops); does not mention 36-inch anywhere

FERC scoping notice for the Appalachian Gateway Project: 'DTI plans to construct and operate approximately 110 miles of 20-, 24-, and 30-inch diameter natural gas pipeline...' and itemizes 'Approximately 43.1 miles of 30-inch diameter pipeline in Marshall County, WV and Greene County, PA; Approximately 54.2 miles of 24-inch diameter pipeline in Greene, Washington, Allegheny, and Westmoreland Counties, PA; Approximately 5.2 miles of 20-inch diameter pipeline loop in Kanawha County, WV and 6 miles of 24-inch diameter pipeline loop in Greene County, PA' -- confirms 20-, 24-, and 30-inch; does not mention 36-inch

resolutions.researcher_notes: Two independent FERC/Federal Register notices for the Appalachian Gateway Project (2010 scoping notice and 2011 EA-availability notice, both naming the pipeline and docket CP10-448) consistently itemize mainline diameters as 20-, 24-, and 30-inch (plus short 16-in and 10-in lateral/loop segments at Kanawha and Wetzel/Harrison Counties). CONTRADICTS THE SHEET: the recorded Diameter value is '20, 24, 36' in, but neither source -- nor any other document opened on this row (constructionequipmentguide.com, Dominion PR Newswire release, Harvard ELR docket-appendix PDF) -- mentions a 36-inch segment anywhere; both FERC notices agree the largest-diameter run (TL-590, 42.3-43.1 mi, Marshall/Greene Counties) is 30-inch, not 36-inch. Likely a transcription error (30 misread/mistyped as 36) that should be corrected on the sheet to '20, 24, 30' in -- flagging for Update rather than overwriting.
